graph.name: TechConnect - Real-Time Sports Telemetry & Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture streams real-time sensor telemetry from smart sports equipment (cricket/rugby balls) for real-time model inference and companion app analytics.

nodes.name: Sports Equipment
nodes.notes: Smart sports balls equipped with embedded sensors, accelerometers, and magnetometers.

nodes.name: Kinesis Stream
nodes.notes: Ingests real-time geometry and movement telemetry data from sports equipment.

nodes.name: Kinesis Firehose
nodes.notes: Streams data to S3 for persistent storage and batch analysis.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Data lake repository used for historical data mining and future ML model training.

nodes.name: Lambda Model Infer
nodes.notes: Runs embedded ML inference model to segment telemetry data and calculate metrics such as ball speed and strike force.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Low-latency storage for processed inference results.

nodes.name: AppSync
nodes.notes: Managed GraphQL API serving real-time event updates over WebSockets/MQTT.

nodes.name: Cognito
nodes.notes: Provides user registration and authentication for fans and players.

nodes.name: Fan / Broadcaster
nodes.notes: End-user companion apps and broadcaster systems subscribing to real-time game telemetry.

edges.notes: Streams raw telemetry data from embedded ball sensors to Kinesis Stream.
Routes stream data to Kinesis Firehose for archiving.
Persists streaming telemetry into the S3 data lake.
Forwards real-time stream data to Lambda for model inference.
Writes processed ML inference insights to DynamoDB.
AppSync reads calculated telemetry metrics from DynamoDB.
Pushes real-time GraphQL subscriptions and notifications to fan and broadcaster client apps.
